action.command:
cd /workspace/project && rm -rf apps/inktest && python3 - <<'PY'
p='AKSES.md'; t=open(p).read()
old="**Verdict:** key valid tapi tidak ada free credit. Sama seperti Cloider — hanya berguna\nkalau mau bayar atau ada promo. Bukan target farming."
new='''**TERBUKTI JALAN (17 Nov).** Deploy end-to-end sukses:
```
ink repo create inktest1
git remote add ink <remote>
git push ink main
ink deploy inktest1 --repo inktest1 --memory 256Mi --vcpu 0.25 --port 8080
```
- status: `queued` -> `deploying` -> **`active`** (~40 dtk)
- endpoint: `https://inktest1.us-east-1.gists.org` -> **HTTP 200** JSON asli
- billing tetap **$0** (kuota belum tercatat di menit pertama)

**Yang perlu diperhatikan:**
- Deploy butuh git repo dulu (`ink repo create`), baru `--repo`.
- `ink service` = daftar, `ink status <n>` = detail, `ink delete <n>` = hapus.
- Endpoint publik HTTPS otomatis, subdomain `.gists.org`.
- Egress gratis, jadi cocok untuk API kecil.

**Verdict:** **berfungsi nyata** — bukan cuma key valid. Tapi tetap **tanpa kredit gratis**
(`includedUsageCents: 0`), jadi bayar per menit sejak detik pertama. Berguna kalau mau
menjalankan bot/API kecil tanpa mengurus server. Bukan sumber kredit farming.'''
assert old in t
open(p,'w').write(t.replace(old,new)); print("ok")
PY
git add -A && git -c user.name="openhands" -c user.email="openhands@all-hands.dev" commit -q -m "INK: verified end-to-end deploy (active, HTTP 200), billing \$0, no free credit

Co-authored-by: openhands <openhands@all-hands.dev>" && git --no-pager log --oneline -1
